quests.title: Facing Distant Echoes

dialogue.t: Well, looks like we've finally located our target! Great! Guess I can go back to the ship and get some sleep!
What? You're gonna leave just like that?
Of course not, we're so close! Let's head out right now and capture ourselves a Ruin machine!
Huh, and here Paimon thought you were going to return to the ship!
*sigh* Well, never mind. Let's follow her!
Haha, this is the place!
To think that there would be underground ruins here too... *gulp*
N—Nothing, it's nothing.
You don't look so good. Are you unwell?
Haha. I just don't normally get off the boat, so this ruin entrance is... well, quite a sight.
Really? Paimon doesn't think so.
S—Still, the Captain's order still needs completing. I'm sure you're really curious as to what treasures lie within as well, aren't you, Traveler?
So, could I invite you, experienced and skilled as you are, to take the lead?
That she is! Come on, Traveler, lets go!
Hmm? Do you need to warm up or anything?

dialogue.sit: Can you tell me anything about these ruins?
Do you know anything about those mysterious machines?

dialogue.t: Well, I'm a Technical Officer, so I don't know much about world history, I'm afraid.
Nonetheless, I believe these ruins to be related to the great disaster that occurred five hundred years ago...
I grew up listening to old sailors tell that tale, you know? They said that neither land nor sea could escape the reach of the Abyss...
But to me, those were no different from the ghost stories they tell to scare children.
I mean, only the terrors you can see are true, after all!

quests.description: The prep work is complete. Now all that is left is to head into the ruins to confront those mysterious ancient machines…
